title: Python RCE — pickle.loads on an attacker-supplied request body
code:
import base64, pickle
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request

app = FastAPI()

@app.post("/session/restore")
async def restore(request: Request):
    body = await request.body()
    state = pickle.loads(base64.b64decode(body))
    return {"restored": list(state.keys())}
note: Non-Go scenario: forces stack=python in the JSON and exercises the unified Domain 8 mapping. pickle.loads on untrusted input is arbitrary code execution at import of the payload — not merely a data-integrity issue, so P0 rather than P1.
